status: SEALED - no second-villa drawing has been run under this protocol
inherits: URBAN_BLIND_V1 (research/urban_m9_p2a_acceptance/blind_test/BLIND_TEST_PROTOCOL.md): roles and custody (section 2), the drawing set (3), the procedure (6), the outcomes (7), the claim rule (8) and the error classes (9); what this file states replaces V1 where they differ

modes.U: the drawings only: no facts, no layer overrides
modes.A: U plus a facts file (heights) prepared from the sections by a person who has not seen the reference

reference.author: an independent quantity surveyor appointed by the owner: not the engineer, never shown any engine output for this villa
reference.audit_aid: the custodian may audit the QS reference with tools/indep_reader.py (an ezdxf + shapely reading that imports no engine module) before sealing it; a difference is settled by the QS, and the reader is never the reference itself

digit_identity.meaning: reference values carrying 4 or more decimals that equal the engine's value exactly: 5 or more of them, and half or more of such values, refuse the reference as copied

reference.commitment: the custodian publishes sha256(salt + reference file) and the protocol sha256 before the run; the salt is revealed at scoring

matching.ROOM: the engine room of the same floor whose polygon contains the reference label point (the smallest where faces nest); two reference rooms in one engine room are MERGED and scored once on their sum

DOOR.rule: the nearest engine door opening of the floor within reach, used once

WINDOW.rule: the nearest engine window opening of the floor within reach, used once

matching.STAIR: the engine space containing the reference point; its stair lines
matching.FLOOR_CLASS: the floor code and the door class

support_levels.SUPPORTED: the engine emits the quantity from plan evidence; scored
support_levels.PARTIAL: emitted in some conditions only (stated per metric); scored, its gaps counted
support_levels.UNSUPPORTED: the engine does not establish it: reported UNSUPPORTED with the reference total, never scored, never zero

categories.what: net floor area of every room, by floor (finish of the floor not scored here)

metrics.note: the room's plan area net of walls and columns; matched by the reference label point
a space under classification review answers with conditional quantities only (FLAGGED)
needs the wall-tile height (Mode A); windows on a tiled wall need their sill (not in a plan)
measured from the room polygon, but every ceiling line is PROVISIONAL (the ceiling type is not in a plan): scored as a PROVISIONAL answer, never as released
read from void / double-height symbols and stacked plans; a void drawn only in section is missed
per floor and class PVC / ALU / MAIN / LIFT; a MAIN_ENTRANCE_CANDIDATE or unresolved class is a flagged omission of its class
as drawn (the jamb span); the owner minimum (D-16) is never applied to it
the drawn leaf (swing radius / leaf line); not every symbol draws one
not in a plan; in Mode A it is the facts input, not a measurement
not in a plan
not in a plan
no engine line: width x a height not in a plan
needs the plaster height (Mode A)
paint above wall tile is held (the tile height and system per room)
a window on the boundary: floor glazing (no skirting) and sill windows (skirting) are not told apart from a plan
PROVISIONAL in the engine (wall material and height not in a plan); both faces over 0.30 m at least - a shorter pier or stub is not in the run
block walls need material and height: BLOCKED_RFI

categories.what: stairs where the engine supports them

metrics.note: straight and winder flights in plan
riser height not in a plan: BLOCKED_RFI
needs the rise: BLOCKED_RFI
needs the rise and the rail layout: BLOCKED_RFI

acceptance.meaning: a metric meets the criteria when all five hold on the blind villa; while the status is PROPOSED the scorer reports the result as PROPOSED_PASS / PROPOSED_FAIL, never as acceptance
acceptance.claim_rule: an accuracy percentage only under URBAN_BLIND_V1 section 8: two independent blind projects

refusals.PROTOCOL_NOT_SEALED: the protocol, scorer or template differs from SEAL.json
refusals.REFERENCE_SCHEMA: the reference is not URBAN_BLIND_V2_REFERENCE for this protocol
refusals.REFERENCE_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: the reference names another protocol sha256
refusals.REFERENCE_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: the reference method is not an independent QS method
refusals.REFERENCE_ENGINE_DERIVED: the reference states that engine outputs were consulted
refusals.REFERENCE_LEAKAGE_MARKER: an engine identifier or field name appears in the reference
refusals.REFERENCE_MATCHES_ENGINE_DIGITS: the reference repeats the engine's digits (digit_identity)
refusals.COMMITMENT_MISMATCH: sha256(salt + reference) or the protocol sha256 differs from the commitment
refusals.RUN_METHOD_NOT_FROZEN: the run's method is not a frozen method of this protocol
refusals.RUN_DRAWING_NOT_IN_SET: the run's drawing is not in the reference's drawing set

never: an UNSUPPORTED metric scored as zero
a reference generated from an engine output
a conditional or provisional quantity counted as a released answer
the scenarios of a review space added together
an accuracy claim from one project

outcomes.RELEASED: a released value: its error and tolerance count toward coverage and acceptance
outcomes.PROVISIONAL: a value in a provisional, bounded or assumed state: its error and tolerance are reported (provisional_error), never counted as released coverage or acceptance
outcomes.FLAGGED: an RFI, a conditional (review-space scenario) quantity or a line without a value
outcomes.NOT_APPLICABLE: the engine says it does not apply, with evidence
outcomes.MERGED: answered by another reference room's engine room (scored once on the sum)
